item.title: Pantograph 1.2.4
item.description:
New

  • Add to Claude Desktop. Settings › Command line and AI agents has a new button that installs Pantograph's tools in the Claude app as an extension: click it, then Install when Claude asks. Claude can then fill in forms, add text, find and read text (scans too), watermark, convert and resize your files using Pantograph. The extension uses the Pantograph in your Applications folder, so it stays up to date with it. Each release also includes Pantograph.mcpb to double-click instead.

If you have Pantograph 1.1.3 or later, it will offer this update by itself (1.1.7 and later install it quietly when you quit). Otherwise, download Pantograph-1.2.4.dmg, open it and drag Pantograph to Applications. Requires macOS 13 or later; runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
